sentences.en: There is no way to confirm that he is alive.
sentences.zh: 没有办法证实他还活着。

sentences.en: I'd like to confirm my hotel reservation on May 5th.
sentences.zh: 我想确认一下5月5日的酒店预订。

sentences.en: He confirmed that it was the wreck of the Titanic.
sentences.zh: 他确认那正是泰坦尼克号的残骸。

senses.zh: 确认；批准；证实；确定；使巩固
